lines.zh: 他在我家门口转了三圈，最后对着门鞠了个躬走了。你干的吧？
lines.en: He bowed to my door and left. Your doing?

lines.zh: 宝贝还在！我决定把它藏进……算了，不告诉你。
lines.en: Treasure's safe! I'll hide it in... no, not telling you.

lines.zh: 他拿走了我的宝贝，还顺手把我的拖鞋摆整齐了。可恶，挺有礼貌。
lines.en: He took it — and tidied my slippers. Rude. Polite, but rude.

lines.zh: 没关系没关系，明天他还会来，你还有机会。
lines.en: It's fine. He'll be back tomorrow. So will you.

lines.zh: 我等你等到茶都凉了。他倒是准时。
lines.en: My tea went cold waiting for you. He was on time.

lines.zh: 他进门的时候还回头找了你一下。好像有点失落？
lines.en: He looked back for you on the way in. A bit disappointed?

lines.zh: 没赶上也没关系，我家门口的花替你看了全程。
lines.en: Missed it? My flowers watched the whole thing for you.

lines.zh: 我听见外面'咚'的一声，然后是一句'妈妈咪呀'。干得好。
lines.en: I heard a thud, then 'mamma mia'. Good job.

lines.zh: 他走的时候哼着歌。今天的歌有点难听。
lines.en: He hummed on his way out. Bad song today.

lines.zh: 他被挡在门外，闻着烤箱的味道流口水。今天的面包算你一半功劳。
lines.en: He drooled outside my oven. Half of today's bread is yours.

lines.zh: 下雨天他滑得像块黄油。我笑到把面粉撒了一地。
lines.en: In the rain he slid like butter. I spilled flour laughing.

lines.zh: 他偷走的不是宝贝，是我刚出炉的那根法棍！……好吧，两样都偷了。
lines.en: He didn't just take the treasure. He took my baguette too.

lines.zh: 第 {looted} 次了。我开始考虑在门口放一盘饼干当买路钱。
lines.en: Time {looted}. I'm thinking of leaving cookies as a toll.

lines.zh: 你没来，他也没吃我留的早饭。两个人都让我操心。
lines.en: You didn't come. He skipped my breakfast. You both worry me.

lines.zh: 我给他留了个面包。他吃完才想起来要偷东西，结果来晚了。
lines.en: I left him a bun. He remembered to steal only after eating it.

lines.zh: ……那个宝贝，是我女儿走之前烤坏的第一块饼干。硬得能砸核桃。谢谢你守着它。——别告诉别人我哭了。
lines.en: ...It's the first cookie my daughter burnt before she left. Hard as rock. Thank you. Don't tell anyone I cried.

lines.zh: 她今天来信了，说城里的面包没我烤的好吃。我想多烤一炉——给你和那个冒失鬼各一个。
lines.en: She wrote today. Says city bread isn't as good. I'll bake extra — one for you, one for that clumsy guy.

lines.zh: 年轻人，你那个香蕉皮的角度，我年轻时候也是这么放的。
lines.en: Young one, I used to place banana peels at that exact angle.

lines.zh: 我在窗边看了一整场，比电视剧好看。明天几点开演？
lines.en: Watched the whole thing from my window. Better than TV. Same time tomorrow?

lines.zh: 他拿走的时候说了声'谢谢奶奶'。我一时不知道该骂他还是给他糖。
lines.en: He said 'thanks, Granny' as he took it. Scold him or give him candy?

lines.zh: 雾这么大，他怎么还找得到我家？你倒是迷路了吧。
lines.en: In this fog he still found my house. You got lost, didn't you?

lines.zh: 我把拐杖横在门口替你守了一会儿。他跨过去了。
lines.en: I laid my cane across the door for you. He stepped over it.

lines.zh: 没人来，我就跟猫说了一下午你们的事。猫睡着了。
lines.en: Nobody came, so I told my cat all about you two. It fell asleep.

lines.zh: 我老伴以前也爱捣蛋，把邮差的帽子挂到钟楼上。……好久没人在我门口这么热闹了。下次带上那个红帽子小伙子，我煮汤。
lines.en: My late husband loved pranks too — hung the mailman's hat on the bell tower. It's been ages since my door was this lively. I'll make soup.

lines.zh: 宝贝是他送我的戒指盒，里面早就空了。可我还是想有人替我守着。谢谢。——你鞋带开了。
lines.en: The treasure's an empty ring box he gave me. Still, I wanted someone to guard it. Thank you. Your shoelace is untied.

lines.zh: 哇！你能教我吗？我想把我哥也弹到天上去！
lines.en: Whoa! Teach me? I wanna launch my brother too!

lines.zh: 那个大石头滚过去的时候我录下来了！……没录上，我太激动了。
lines.en: I filmed the boulder! ...I didn't. Too excited.

lines.zh: 他把我的弹珠拿走了！……但是他教了我一个后空翻。扯平？
lines.en: He took my marbles! ...but he taught me a backflip. Even?

lines.zh: 我决定了，长大当马里奥。他每天都赢。
lines.en: Decided. I'm gonna be Mario when I grow up. He always wins.

lines.zh: 你迟到了！我已经自己布置了三个陷阱，全踩中我自己了。
lines.en: You're late! I set three traps myself. Stepped in all of them.

lines.zh: 你不来，我只好自己当捣蛋鬼。我把自己关在门外了。
lines.en: You didn't come, so I played prankster. Locked myself out.

lines.zh: 学校里没人跟我玩。但是你和那个马里奥每天都来我家门口打架。……这算朋友吗？算吧。
lines.en: Nobody plays with me at school. But you two fight at my door every day... that counts as friends, right? Right.

lines.zh: 我今天在学校讲了你们的事，大家都围过来听。我第一次被这么多人看着。谢谢你。——明天我能当陷阱吗？
lines.en: I told your story at school. Everyone listened. First time so many people looked at me. Thanks. Can I be a trap tomorrow?

lines.zh: 镇公所正式宣布：今天的治安由一位匿名的捣蛋鬼负责。别声张。
lines.en: Town Hall officially announces: today's security was provided by an anonymous prankster.

lines.zh: 钟楼又响了。我已经第五次在会议上假装那是我安排的。
lines.en: The bell rang again. Fifth time I've pretended I scheduled it.

lines.zh: 他偷走了镇长印章。今天镇上所有文件都盖着蘑菇图案。
lines.en: He stole the town seal. Every document today has a mushroom stamp.

lines.zh: 我准备给他发个'年度最勤劳访客'奖。他应得的。
lines.en: Planning a 'Most Diligent Visitor' award for him. He's earned it.

lines.zh: 你没来，我只好亲自堵门。我的腰……
lines.en: You didn't show, so I blocked the door myself. My back...

lines.zh: 我在会议记录里写了：'今日，捣蛋鬼缺席。'
lines.en: I wrote in the minutes: 'Today, the prankster was absent.'

lines.zh: 我当了二十年镇长，镇上从来没这么吵过。说实话——我喜欢。好像大家又醒过来了。——修路的钱你们出。
lines.en: Twenty years as mayor, and the town's never been this loud. Honestly? I like it. Like everyone woke up. You're paying for the roads.

lines.zh: 我想在广场立块牌子：'这里有人每天守着别人的宝贝'。不写名字。你会知道是你。
lines.en: I want a plaque in the square: 'Someone here guards other people's treasures every day.' No name. You'll know.

lines.zh: 他摔倒的姿势太完美了，我画下来了。题目叫《重力》。
lines.en: His fall was perfect. I painted it. Title: 'Gravity'.

lines.zh: 风把他吹得像一面旗。下一幅画就叫《不屈》。
lines.en: The wind made him flap like a flag. Next painting: 'Unbowed'.

lines.zh: 他偷走了我的画！……他居然觉得它值钱。我有点感动。
lines.en: He stole my painting! ...He thinks it's worth something. I'm touched.

lines.zh: 我开始画他偷东西的样子，拿去卖，赚得比被偷的还多。
lines.en: I paint him stealing now and sell those. I'm making a profit.

lines.zh: 你没来，画面里少了一个人。构图都歪了。
lines.en: You didn't come. The composition's off without you.

lines.zh: 空的门口也挺好看的。……不，还是你们俩在比较好看。
lines.en: An empty doorway is nice too. ...No, it's better with you two.

lines.zh: 我已经三年画不出东西了。这几天我画了十二张，全是你们俩。……谢谢你们没让我闲着。——颜料钱算谁的？
lines.en: I hadn't painted in three years. This week: twelve, all of you two. Thanks for not letting me sit still. Who pays for the paint?

lines.zh: 我要办个小画展，题目叫《每天都在输的马里奥》。他看了会笑的吧？会吧。
lines.en: I'm holding a little show: 'Mario, Who Loses Every Day.' He'll laugh, right? Right.

lines.zh: 我值夜班的，白天的事本来不归我管。但这次……干得漂亮。
lines.en: I'm night shift. Daytime's not my job. But... nice work.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来那一下，我以为是我的退休通知。原来是你。
lines.en: When the lightning struck I thought it was my retirement notice. It was you.

lines.zh: 我睡着了。别跟镇长说。
lines.en: I fell asleep. Don't tell the mayor.

lines.zh: 我在门口挂了个'内有恶犬'的牌子。我没有狗。他也知道。
lines.en: I hung a 'Beware of Dog' sign. I don't have a dog. He knows.

lines.zh: 你没赶上？我也经常没赶上。人生就是这样，伙计。
lines.en: Missed it? Me too, often. That's life, pal.

lines.zh: 我替你站了一会儿岗。他冲我敬了个礼就进去了。
lines.en: I stood guard for you. He saluted me and went right in.

lines.zh: 我守了一辈子门，从来没人谢过我。所以——谢谢你，替我守了一次。——现在我能去睡觉了吗？
lines.en: I've guarded doors all my life. Nobody ever thanked me. So — thank you for guarding mine. Can I sleep now?

lines.zh: 其实我年轻时就是那个偷东西的。后来有人在门口守着我，我就不偷了。……他会明白的。慢慢来。
lines.en: Truth is, I was the thief when I was young. Then someone guarded a door against me, and I stopped. He'll get it. Give it time.

lines.zh: 听说今天马里奥换了一双新鞋，跑得更响了。
lines.en: Word is Mario got new shoes. Louder now.

lines.zh: 面包店今天的特价：防滑面包。不知道为什么卖得特别好。
lines.en: Bakery special: non-slip bread. Selling oddly well.

lines.zh: 有人在钟楼上留了一张纸条：'别信钟声'。字很丑。
lines.en: Someone left a note on the bell tower: 'don't trust the bell.' Bad handwriting.

lines.zh: 昨天全镇的宝贝都还在！镇长说要放半天假，然后自己去上班了。
lines.en: Every treasure survived yesterday! The mayor declared a half-holiday, then went to work.

lines.zh: 昨天马里奥满载而归。今天他走路有点飘，肯定是骄傲了。
lines.en: Mario cleaned up yesterday. He's strutting today. Pride comes before a banana peel.

lines.zh: 昨天你们俩同时倒下，全镇的人都在争到底算谁赢。
lines.en: You both went down at once yesterday. The whole town's still arguing who won.

lines.zh: 马里奥昨天被抬回家了。今早他已经在门口做热身操，还冲每户人家眨眼。
lines.en: Mario was carried home yesterday. This morning he's stretching outside, winking at every house.

lines.zh: 昨天那个捣蛋鬼被自己的机关放倒了。大家都假装没看见。……大部分人。
lines.en: The prankster got flattened by their own trap yesterday. Everyone pretends they didn't see. Mostly.

lines.zh: 昨天镇上响了 {ybighits} 次大动静。王大爷说他的假牙都震松了。
lines.en: {ybighits} big crashes yesterday. Old Wang says his dentures came loose.

lines.zh: 下雨了。今天的香蕉皮会格外滑，请大家注意脚下——尤其是你，马里奥。
lines.en: Rain today. Banana peels will be extra slick. Watch your step. Especially you, Mario.

lines.zh: 大雾。今天谁跟谁撞上都别吵架，可能是捣蛋鬼。
lines.en: Thick fog. If you bump into someone, don't argue. Could be the prankster.

lines.zh: 你发现没有？自从他们俩开始闹，镇上的人见面会打招呼了。……以前大家都只低头走路的。
lines.en: Notice? Since those two started, people say hello again. We used to walk with our heads down.

lines.zh: 今天……算你厉害。明天我起得更早！
lines.en: Today... you got me. I'm waking up earlier tomorrow!

lines.zh: 我的鞋里全是香蕉。你知道这有多难洗吗？
lines.en: My shoes are full of banana. Do you know how hard that is to wash?

lines.zh: 嘿嘿，全拿到了！明天你得更努力才行哦。
lines.en: Got 'em all! Try harder tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你今天是不是故意放水？……不像。好吧，我就是太强了。
lines.en: Were you going easy on me? ...Nah. I'm just that good.

lines.zh: 我决定了，明天我要倒着走。看你怎么办。
lines.en: Decided. Tomorrow I walk backwards. Let's see you handle that.

lines.zh: 今天的宝贝我会好好收着的。……收在哪来着？
lines.en: I'll keep today's treasures safe. ...Where'd I put them?

lines.zh: 回家洗澡。明天见。
lines.en: Going home for a bath. See you tomorrow.

lines.zh: 今天走了好多路。我的胡子都累了。
lines.en: Walked so much today. Even my mustache is tired.

lines.zh: 我……我只是躺一会儿。不是输了。是在看云。
lines.en: I'm... just lying down. Not losing. Watching clouds.

lines.zh: 被雷劈了。这不算你赢的吧？……算吗？
lines.en: Struck by lightning. That doesn't count as your win, right? ...Right?

lines.zh: 喂，你没事吧？下次别站在自己的炮口前面了。……我是说真的。
lines.en: Hey, you okay? Don't stand in front of your own cannon. ...I mean it.

lines.zh: 我们俩一起躺在这儿。说真的，今天天气不错。
lines.en: So we're both lying here. Honestly, nice weather today.

lines.zh: 今天那一串连锁……我要承认，挺好看的。
lines.en: That chain today... I'll admit, it was beautiful.

lines.zh: 你知道吗，以前我每天都是一个人跑来跑去。现在至少有人在等我。……明天见，捣蛋鬼。
lines.en: You know, I used to run around alone every day. Now someone's waiting for me. See you tomorrow, prankster.

lines.zh: 我不是真的想要那些宝贝。我只是想让大家记得有我这个人。……你好像也一样？
lines.en: I don't really want the treasures. I just want people to remember I'm here. ...You too, maybe?
